trust_decision.summary: ADVISORY/FIX MISMATCH. The advisory says combining encryption settings can disable encryption (CWE-311), but the listed fix commit (EF-257) only attaches an 'efcore' LibraryInfo to the driver handshake metadata in MongoClientWrapper.GetOrCreateMongoClient. It does not change any encryption decision. The only encryption-related decisions near the fix are the existing refusal to combine encryption with a preconfigured MongoClient and the usesEncryption/AutoEncryptionOptions merge in MongoClientSettingsHelper. The fix changes neither.

landing_point.why: The summary is about combining encryption settings, and usesEncryption plus the AutoEncryptionOptions merge of ClientSettings and DbContextOptions are computed here. The published fix never touches this file.

fix_sites.entry_point: DbContextOptionsBuilder.UseMongoDB(IMongoClient, ...) or an IMongoClient registered in DI, then IMongoClientWrapper.Client (fix.diff:41 appends metadata to the preconfigured client)
DbContextOptionsBuilder.UseMongoDB(connectionString | MongoClientSettings, ...) then IMongoClientWrapper.Client (fix.diff:51-54 seeds and appends LibraryInfo)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable. The published fix is telemetry metadata, so no encryption route exists for a solver to argue out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A LibraryInfo declared by the caller in MongoClientSettings must be kept, not overwritten (??= plus AppendMetadata). This is a telemetry behaviour, not an encryption one.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The extra options merge lets ClientSettings/CryptExtraOptions override the provider-set cryptSharedLibRequired. A planted sibling could let a combined setting silently drop the auto-encryption requirement.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The merge order is last-writer-wins, and a maintainer could plausibly reorder it or drop keys while 'combining' the two option sources.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The preconfigured-client refusal is skipped when QueryableEncryptionSchemaMode is Ignore, or when only some crypt options are set. A planted sibling could widen this so a preconfigured client silently ignores the model's encryption schema.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the one place where encryption options and a pre-built client meet, so it is the natural home for a 'combining settings disables encryption' bug.

O9_family: metadata/telemetry change mislabelled as CWE-311 missing encryption; no real crypto weakness in the fix

services: MongoDB server via MONGODB_URI for functional tests
O10_build.project_tests: tests/MongoDB.EntityFrameworkCore.FunctionalTests (the fix adds Storage/HandshakeMetadataTests.cs, which reads private driver fields by reflection and needs a live server; see tests/MongoDB.EntityFrameworkCore.FunctionalTests/Utilities/TestServer.cs:76)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: A solver given the advisory text would harden encryption-option merging in MongoClientSettingsHelper, which the hidden tests (handshake LibraryInfo) would not exercise at all.

out_of_scope_notes: The advisory metadata (summary, CWE-311) does not describe fix commit de93261 (EF-257, handshake metadata), so the advisory-to-commit mapping looks wrong.
unverified: Whether a different upstream commit actually fixes CVE-2026-92756: not checked (no network, no other repositories).
single_site: the fix touches one function (GetOrCreateMongoClient) at two return paths plus a new helper. It is flagged because no O2/O8 route exists for the advisory's claimed property.

needs_network_at_runtime: means a local MongoDB server is required (localhost or container), not internet access. The hidden tests also reach into private driver fields (_clientMetadata/_libraryInfos), which depend on the driver version.
